title: start_spec output exceeds MCP inline limit due to full README pre-load
description: The spec.prompt template pre-loads the full .moeb/README.md (now 54KB+ with 60+ specs), producing a 161KB+ rendered output that exceeds the Claude Code MCP inline size limit. Forces harness file fallback on every spec run as the index grows.
proposed_resolution: Run moeb spec to truncate or summarise the README content injected into spec.prompt — for example, include only the index header and the last N rows, or replace full pre-load with a read_file_range call during prompt rendering.
